description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, date formatting, and JWT token management, including token validation and storage handling.

methods.name: myPadStart
methods.description: Pads the start of a string or number with a specified string to reach a target length.

methods.name: chunker
methods.description: Inserts a specified string after every n characters in the input string or number.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on the provided date format.

methods.name: getAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from local storage.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Stores the provided token into local storage.

methods.name: removeAuthToken
methods.description: Removes the authentication token from local storage.

methods.name: isValidToken
methods.description: Checks if the stored token is valid (not expired) and resolves or rejects accordingly.
